title: Battle of Badgam
summary: Major Somnath Sharma leads a legendary defense against tribal raiders.
content: A critical engagement in the 1947 Indo-Pakistani War where D Company of the 4th Battalion, Kumaon Regiment, delayed tribal raiders from reaching Srinagar airfield. Major Somnath Sharma was posthumously awarded India's first Param Vir Chakra.

title: Operation Bison (Zoji La)
summary: Historic employment of tanks at high altitude.
content: Operation Bison was the Indian Army's historic assault using Stuart tanks at the Zoji La pass (11,575 ft) to dislodge Pakistani forces and relieve the garrison at Leh.

title: Naval Action at Mormugao
summary: INS Betwa and INS Beas engage the Portuguese sloop NRP Afonso de Albuquerque.
content: During Operation Vijay, the Indian Navy engaged the Portuguese warship NRP Afonso de Albuquerque off Mormugao harbor. The Portuguese ship was heavily damaged and beached.

title: Battle of Namka Chu
summary: Initial massive Chinese assault marking the start of the 1962 war.
content: Chinese forces launched a massive surprise attack across the Namka Chu river against ill-equipped Indian positions, leading to heavy Indian casualties and the beginning of the Sino-Indian War.

title: Battle of Rezang La
summary: Ahir Company's legendary last stand in Ladakh.
content: 120 men of C Company, 13 Kumaon, led by Major Shaitan Singh, made a legendary last stand against thousands of Chinese troops at Rezang La, preventing a breakthrough into the Chushul Valley.

title: Battle of Haji Pir
summary: Daring capture of the strategic Haji Pir Pass.
content: Indian forces launched a daring assault to capture the Haji Pir pass, cutting off the main infiltration route of Pakistani militants during Operation Gibraltar. Major Ranjit Singh Dayal led the successful capture.

title: Battle of Asal Uttar
summary: One of the largest tank battles fought during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965.
content: The Battle of Asal Uttar was one of the largest tank battles fought during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965. It resulted in a decisive Indian victory and the destruction of a large number of Pakistani Patton tanks. Company Quarter Master Havildar Abdul Hamid destroyed multiple tanks and was awarded the Param Vir Chakra.

title: Battle of Chawinda
summary: Major tank battle in the Sialkot sector.
content: One of the largest tank engagements since World War II, Indian armor attempted to cut off the Pakistani supply line in the Sialkot sector, leading to a massive clash of tanks at Chawinda.

title: Operation Trident
summary: Offensive operation by the Indian Navy on Pakistan's port city of Karachi.
content: Operation Trident was an offensive operation launched by the Indian Navy on Pakistan's port city of Karachi during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971. It saw the first use of anti-ship missiles in combat in the region, sinking multiple Pakistani vessels.

title: Battle of Longewala
summary: Defensive battle in the western sector.
content: 120 Indian soldiers of the 23 Punjab regiment, commanded by Major Kuldip Singh Chandpuri, held off a massive Pakistani armored thrust at the border post of Longewala, supported by the Indian Air Force Hunter jets.

title: Battle of Basantar
summary: Fierce armored and infantry battle in the Shakargarh sector.
content: A decisive Indian victory in the western sector involving intense armored combat. 2nd Lt Arun Khetarpal displayed exceptional bravery destroying several Pakistani tanks before falling in combat.

title: Tangail Airdrop
summary: Largest airborne operation by Indian forces.
content: A massive airdrop of the 2nd Battalion of the Parachute Regiment at Tangail, East Pakistan, aimed at capturing the Poongli Bridge and cutting off the retreat of the Pakistani 93rd Brigade.

title: Operation Rajiv (Capture of Quaid Post)
summary: Capture of a strategic post on the Siachen glacier.
content: A daring high-altitude assault led by Naib Subedar Bana Singh to capture the crucial Quaid Post at 21,153 feet, which gave Pakistan a commanding view of the Saltoro ridge. It was later renamed Bana Top.

title: Infiltration Discovered
summary: Local shepherds report armed men on the heights.
content: Local shepherds in Batalik sector noticed unknown armed personnel constructing bunkers on the ridgelines. Initial patrols sent by the Indian Army are ambushed.

title: Battle of Tololing
summary: Crucial victory secures the strategic peak.
content: After weeks of bitter fighting, the Rajputana Rifles capture the Tololing peak. This was the turning point of the war, providing a foothold for further assaults.

title: Capture of Point 5140
summary: Capt. Vikram Batra leads the assault.
content: Captured by 13 JAK RIF. Capt. Vikram Batra gave his famous victory signal 'Yeh Dil Maange More!' after successfully capturing this high-altitude feature.

title: Capture of Tiger Hill
summary: The most prominent peak falls after a grueling assault.
content: The 18 Grenadiers, supported by artillery and the 8 Sikh, launch a multi-directional assault on Tiger Hill. The peak is captured after intense close-quarters combat.

title: Operation Safed Sagar
summary: Air force strikes and Pakistani retreat.
content: Major logistics camps like Muntho Dhalo were destroyed by IAF airstrikes using laser-guided bombs. Faced with overwhelming military pressure, the infiltrators retreat.

title: Operation Polo
summary: Police action to annex the princely state of Hyderabad.
content: Operation Polo was the code name of the Hyderabad 'police action' in September 1948, by the then newly independent Dominion of India against Hyderabad State.

title: Operation Cactus
summary: Indian armed forces intervention to thwart a coup attempt in the Maldives.
content: Operation Cactus was an intervention by the Indian Armed Forces to thwart a coup d'état attempt against the government of President Maumoon Abdul Gayoom in the Maldives.
